cameroon/adventure.caption: Summit, Crater, Coast
cameroon/adventure.description: The Guinness route to 4,095 m, down the north flank to Mann's Spring, and out to the sea on the same trip.
cameroon/adventure.alt: walkers crossing grass slopes below the summit huts on Mount Cameroon

cameroon/architecture.caption: Chefferie and Colonial Buea
cameroon/architecture.description: Bamileke chefferie compounds with carved posts and conical roofs, and the German Schloss on the hill above Buea.
cameroon/architecture.alt: a Bamileke chieftaincy compound with carved posts and a conical thatched roof, Cameroon

cameroon/beaches.caption: Black Sand and Warm Water
cameroon/beaches.description: Volcanic grey-black sand at Limbe, white sand and fishing pirogues at Kribi, warm all year on both.
cameroon/beaches.alt: surf breaking on volcanic black sand at dusk on the Cameroon coast near Limbe

cameroon/cities.caption: Douala and Yaounde
cameroon/cities.description: The port that moves the country and the hill capital that governs it, ninety minutes apart by air and nothing alike.
cameroon/cities.alt: a street in the Bonapriso quarter of Douala, Cameroon

cameroon/crafts.caption: The Foumban Bronze Casters
cameroon/crafts.description: Lost-wax bronze, beaded thrones and carved masks made on the craft street the same way they were three centuries ago.
cameroon/crafts.alt: a bronze caster working molten metal in a workshop at Foumban, Cameroon

cameroon/culture.caption: The Grassfields Kingdoms
cameroon/culture.description: Bamileke and Bamoun chiefdoms in the west, still functioning, with palaces, secret societies and their own calendars.
cameroon/culture.alt: a carved and beaded royal throne inside a palace museum at Foumban, Cameroon

cameroon/eco-tourism.query: Cameroon forest guide identifying tree species inside ecotourism conservation
cameroon/eco-tourism.alt: a forest guide identifying a tree species inside Korup rainforest, Cameroon

cameroon/family-community.caption: Village and Mountain Together
cameroon/family-community.description: Guides and porters come from the mountain villages in rotation, and the trail money goes back into the village fund.
cameroon/family-community.alt: villagers and guides repairing a stone section of mountain trail together, Cameroon

cameroon/festivals.query: Cameroon masked dancers horsemen nguon festival foumban celebration dance
cameroon/festivals.alt: masked dancers and horsemen at the Nguon festival in Foumban, Cameroon

cameroon/food.caption: Ndole, Poulet DG and Grilled Fish
cameroon/food.description: Bitterleaf and groundnut ndolé, plantain, and whole fish grilled on the sand at Kribi within sight of the boat.
cameroon/food.alt: grilled fish and plantain served at a beachside stall in Kribi, Cameroon

cameroon/forests.caption: Inside Korup
cameroon/forests.description: One of the oldest rainforests in Africa, with a canopy suspension bridge over the Mana river and 400 tree species.
cameroon/forests.alt: a canopy suspension bridge over a river inside Korup rainforest, Cameroon

cameroon/heritage.caption: Dja, Rhumsiki and the Mandara
cameroon/heritage.description: The Dja Faunal Reserve is UNESCO World Heritage; the volcanic spires above Rhumsiki are the image on the old banknote.
cameroon/heritage.alt: volcanic rock spires rising from farmland at Rhumsiki in the Mandara mountains, Cameroon

cameroon/hero.query: Cameroon upper slopes mount cameroon above atlantic landscape iconic
cameroon/hero.alt: the upper slopes of Mount Cameroon at dawn above the Atlantic

cameroon/hidden-gems.caption: The 1999 Lava Fields
cameroon/hidden-gems.description: Black lava tongues from the 1999 and 2000 flows running down to the sea near Bakingili, with green already coming back.
cameroon/hidden-gems.alt: black solidified lava flows reaching the sea on the flank of Mount Cameroon

cameroon/historic-sites.caption: The Sultan's Palace
cameroon/historic-sites.description: The 1917 palace at Foumban and its museum of the Bamoun kings, plus the German colonial buildings still standing in Buea.
cameroon/historic-sites.alt: the Sultan's Palace at Foumban with its museum of the Bamoun kings, Cameroon

cameroon/lakes-rivers.query: Cameroon brown benoue river gallery forest along lake water
cameroon/lakes-rivers.alt: the wide brown Benoue river with gallery forest along the bank, Cameroon

cameroon/local-life.caption: Marche Central, Motos, Rain
cameroon/local-life.description: Bilingual, loud and unbothered: Douala's markets, the moto-taxis, and the sudden rain everyone waits out under an awning.
cameroon/local-life.alt: traders and moto-taxis in a busy Douala market street, Cameroon

cameroon/luxury.caption: Kribi, Slowly
cameroon/luxury.description: Small beach hotels south of Kribi, a driver who knows the road, and nothing at all scheduled after lunch.
cameroon/luxury.alt: a small beach hotel terrace above the sand at Kribi, Cameroon

cameroon/mountains.alt: trekkers on the open upper slopes of Mount Cameroon above the tree line

cameroon/outdoor.caption: The Ring Road on Foot
cameroon/outdoor.description: Crater lakes, tea slopes and the Ring Road through the Bamenda highlands, walkable in sections between 1,200 and 2,000 m.
cameroon/outdoor.alt: open dry-season slopes and ridge lines on Mount Cameroon

cameroon/photography.caption: Cloud on the Rainforest
cameroon/photography.description: Wet season cloud sitting on the forest above Buea, and dry season light on the Mandara spires — two countries, one lens.
cameroon/photography.alt: cloud and rain sitting on the rainforest above Buea, Cameroon

cameroon/safari.query: Cameroon elephants giraffe dry season waterhole waza safari game drive
cameroon/safari.alt: elephants and giraffe at a dry-season waterhole in Waza National Park, Cameroon

cameroon/traditional-people.caption: Fulani, Mafa and Bamileke
cameroon/traditional-people.description: Two hundred and fifty ethnic groups and as many languages, from the Mafa terraces of the Mandara to the Fulani of the Sahel.
cameroon/traditional-people.alt: a Mafa farmer on the terraced slopes of the Mandara mountains, Cameroon

cameroon/waterfalls.caption: Where the River Meets the Sea
cameroon/waterfalls.description: The Lobé falls near Kribi drop straight over black rock into the Atlantic — one of very few waterfalls on earth that do.
cameroon/waterfalls.alt: the Lobe waterfalls pouring over rock directly into the Atlantic near Kribi, Cameroon

cameroon/why-visit.caption: Everything, Within One Border
cameroon/why-visit.description: Sea level to Sahel in nine hundred kilometres, French and English on the same road, and almost nobody else on it.
cameroon/why-visit.alt: a 4x4 on a red laterite road between rainforest and highland farmland, Cameroon

cameroon/wildlife.alt: forest elephants among buttressed trees in Korup National Park, Cameroon

uganda/adventure.caption: Grade Five on the Nile
uganda/adventure.description: White-water rafting below the source at Jinja, plus bungee, kayaking and the long walk up Sipi.
uganda/adventure.alt: white-water rafting on the Nile rapids at Jinja, Uganda

uganda/architecture.caption: Minaret, Dome and Thatch
uganda/architecture.description: The Uganda National Mosque, the Namirembe and Rubaga cathedrals facing each other across two hills.
uganda/architecture.alt: the minaret of the Uganda National Mosque above Kampala

uganda/beaches.caption: The Ssese Islands
uganda/beaches.description: Freshwater beaches and fishing villages on Lake Victoria, an hour and a half by ferry from Entebbe.
uganda/beaches.alt: a sandy freshwater shore and fishing boats on the Ssese Islands, Uganda

uganda/cities.caption: Kampala on Seven Hills
uganda/cities.description: A capital built across hills and traffic, with the Gaddafi Mosque minaret giving the best view of all of it.
uganda/cities.alt: the hills and rooftops of Kampala seen from the Gaddafi Mosque minaret, Uganda

uganda/crafts.caption: Bark Cloth and Basketry
uganda/crafts.description: Bark cloth from the mutuba fig, made in Buganda for six hundred years and now UNESCO-listed.
uganda/crafts.alt: a craftsman beating bark cloth from a mutuba fig tree, Uganda

uganda/culture.caption: The Kingdom of Buganda
uganda/culture.description: Uganda's kingdoms were never abolished for long — Buganda, Bunyoro and Toro still hold court.
uganda/culture.alt: a Buganda kingdom drummer in ceremonial bark cloth

uganda/eco-tourism.caption: The Gorilla Permit
uganda/eco-tourism.description: Permit revenue funds the park and pays a share to the parishes around it — which is why the gorilla numbers are rising.
uganda/eco-tourism.alt: rangers and trackers setting out on a gorilla trek in Bwindi, Uganda

uganda/family-community.caption: Villages at the Forest Edge
uganda/family-community.description: Community walks in Buhoma and Nkuringo, run by the villages that share the forest with the gorillas.
uganda/family-community.alt: a community village walk beside the forest edge at Buhoma, Uganda

uganda/festivals.caption: Imbalu and Nyege Nyege
uganda/festivals.description: The Bagisu Imbalu season in the east, and four days of music on the banks of the Nile at Jinja.
uganda/festivals.alt: drummers and dancers at the Imbalu ceremony in eastern Uganda

uganda/food.caption: Rolex, Matoke, Luwombo
uganda/food.description: Steamed green banana with groundnut sauce, chicken cooked in banana leaf, and an egg rolled in a chapati on every corner.
uganda/food.alt: a street vendor cooking rolex chapati and eggs in Kampala, Uganda

uganda/forests.caption: Kibale and Bwindi
uganda/forests.description: Thirteen primate species in Kibale, and in Bwindi a forest so old and so thick it was never logged.
uganda/forests.alt: dense canopy and buttressed trees in Kibale Forest, Uganda

uganda/heritage.caption: Kingdoms Still Standing
uganda/heritage.description: Royal drums, regalia and clan structures that survived the protectorate, the 1966 crisis and the 1970s.
uganda/heritage.alt: royal regalia and drums inside a Buganda kingdom palace

uganda/hero.caption: The Pearl of Africa
uganda/hero.description: Gorilla forest, the Mountains of the Moon and the Nile leaving Lake Victoria — all inside one small, green country.
uganda/hero.alt: mist over the forested hills of Bwindi Impenetrable National Park at sunrise, Uganda

uganda/hidden-gems.caption: Kidepo Valley
uganda/hidden-gems.description: The furthest park from Kampala and the emptiest: Narus valley, the Morungole range, and cheetah nobody photographs.
uganda/hidden-gems.alt: the Narus valley and mountains of Kidepo Valley National Park, Uganda

uganda/historic-sites.caption: The Kasubi Tombs
uganda/historic-sites.description: The burial ground of four Buganda kings, thatched, enormous and rebuilt by the clans who have always maintained it.
uganda/historic-sites.alt: the great thatched dome of the Kasubi Tombs in Kampala, Uganda

uganda/lakes-rivers.caption: Where the Nile Begins
uganda/lakes-rivers.description: The Nile leaves Lake Victoria at Jinja; Lake Bunyonyi holds twenty-nine islands and no bilharzia.
uganda/lakes-rivers.alt: the islands and terraced shores of Lake Bunyonyi, Uganda

uganda/local-life.caption: Boda Bodas and Owino
uganda/local-life.description: The boda boda is the transport system; Owino market is where the whole city goes to buy everything.
uganda/local-life.alt: boda boda motorcycle taxis waiting at a busy Kampala street stage, Uganda

uganda/luxury.caption: Lodges at the Forest Edge
uganda/luxury.description: Small lodges on the Bwindi ridge and the Kazinga Channel, close enough to walk to the trailhead after breakfast.
uganda/luxury.alt: a lodge terrace overlooking the Bwindi forest ridge at dawn, Uganda

uganda/mountains.caption: The Mountains of the Moon
uganda/mountains.description: The Rwenzori range holds glaciers three degrees from the equator, and Margherita Peak at 5,109 m.
uganda/mountains.alt: the glaciated peaks of the Rwenzori Mountains above the moorland, Uganda

uganda/nature.caption: Green, End to End
uganda/nature.description: Crater lakes around Fort Portal, papyrus swamp on the Nile, and the Rwenzori snowline sitting on the equator.
uganda/nature.alt: the crater lakes and green hills around Fort Portal, Uganda

uganda/outdoor.caption: Sipi, Elgon, Bisoke
uganda/outdoor.description: Three waterfalls and a coffee walk at Sipi, then the long crater rim of Mount Elgon above it.
uganda/outdoor.alt: the Sipi Falls dropping off the Mount Elgon escarpment, Uganda

uganda/photography.caption: Crater Lakes at First Light
uganda/photography.description: The Ndali-Kasenda crater field before the haze lifts, and the Ishasha fig trees in the late afternoon.
uganda/photography.alt: morning mist on the Ndali-Kasenda crater lakes near Fort Portal, Uganda

uganda/safari.caption: Queen Elizabeth and Kidepo
uganda/safari.description: Kob on the Kasenyi plains, elephant on the Kazinga Channel, and Kidepo Valley with almost nobody in it.
uganda/safari.alt: elephants on the Kazinga Channel in Queen Elizabeth National Park, Uganda

uganda/traditional-people.caption: Batwa and Karamojong
uganda/traditional-people.description: The Batwa, forest people of the southwest, and the Karamojong cattle-keepers of the northeast plains.
uganda/traditional-people.alt: a Karamojong herder with cattle on the plains of Karamoja, Uganda

uganda/waterfalls.caption: Murchison, Through the Gap
uganda/waterfalls.description: The entire Victoria Nile forced through a seven-metre gap and dropped forty-three metres into the gorge below.
uganda/waterfalls.alt: the Nile forcing through the narrow gap at Murchison Falls, Uganda

uganda/why-visit.caption: Half the World's Gorillas
uganda/why-visit.description: Nowhere else puts gorillas, chimpanzees, the Big Five, a snowline and the Nile within one week of driving.
uganda/why-visit.alt: a silverback mountain gorilla resting in the Bwindi undergrowth, Uganda

uganda/wildlife.caption: Wildlife Encounters
uganda/wildlife.description: Mountain gorillas in Bwindi, chimpanzees in Kibale, and tree-climbing lions in the Ishasha sector.
uganda/wildlife.alt: a mountain gorilla in the Bwindi Impenetrable Forest, Uganda
